### <span class="method-badge" data-method="DELETE">DELETE</span> `/nodes/{node}/san/nvmeof/controller/{controller}`

```ts
proxmox.nodes.$(node).san.nvmeof.controller.$(controller).$delete()
```

Disconnect one fabrics controller. Refuse when a namespace in use has no other usable path. A storage still listing the portal reconnects it on activation.

Returns `string`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `controller` | string | yes | The fabrics controller name, for example nvme3. |
| `node` | string | yes | The cluster node name. — format `pve-node` |
| `portal` | string |  | Refuse unless the controller still has this portal. — ≤ 128 chars |
| `subsysnqn` | string |  | Refuse unless the controller still has this subsystem NQN. — ≤ 223 chars |

<p class="api-viewer-link"><a href="https://pve.proxmox.com/pve-docs/api-viewer/index.html#/nodes/{node}/san/nvmeof/controller/{controller}" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">Open in the Proxmox API viewer</a></p>
